interest: Dillon, Read & Co.'s schedule of defaulted German, Polish, Milan and Japanese dollar bonds outstanding in 1947.
overview: July 1947 letter from Dillon, Read & Co. to Secretary Marshall asking about protection for holders of defaulted German and Polish dollar bonds, with a schedule of issues including Japanese electric utility bonds.

subfiles.about: Dillon, Read & Co. requests information from Secretary of State George C. Marshall regarding U.S. government efforts to protect American holders of defaulted German and Polish foreign dollar bonds.
subfiles.summary: Dillon, Read & Co. asks Secretary Marshall what the State Department is doing to protect American holders of prewar German and Polish dollar bonds.
subfiles.title: Letter from Dillon, Read & Co. to Secretary of State George C. Marshall regarding German and Polish dollar bonds

subfiles.about: A detailed schedule itemizing defaulted German, Polish, Italian, and Japanese foreign dollar bond issues underwritten by Dillon, Read & Co. syndicates.
subfiles.summary: Dillon, Read & Co.'s Schedule 'A' of defaulted foreign dollar bonds as of April 15, 1947: German, Polish, Milan and Japanese electric power issues.
subfiles.title: Schedule 'A': Record of Defaulted Foreign Dollar Bond Issues Underwritten by Dillon, Read & Co. Groups
